pages.text: $(thing)Iridescent Altar/$ is a crafting recipe type that uses the $(item)Iridescent Package Crafting Altar/$ to craft recipes craftable in a Iridescent Altar.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)Iridescent Package Crafting Altar/$, you must build the Iridescent Altar structure around it, shown on the next page.$(p)You must also put enough $(item)Marked Spectral Relays/$ in a 7x7 area around the crafter.$(p)The crafter requires power and starlight.

pages.title: Usage (cont.)
pages.text: You can $(thing)$(k:sneak) + $(k:use)/$ with an empty hand on an idle $(item)Iridescent Package Crafting Altar/$ to check its currently usable and required amount of $(item)Marked Spectral Relays/$.$(p)Items crafted by the $(item)Iridescent Package Crafting Altar/$ will be ejected into adjacent inventories.

pages.title: AE2 Integration
pages.text: The $(item)Iridescent Package Crafting Altar/$ can be connected to an $(thing)ME Network/$.$(p)It will extract power to use, and instead eject crafted items into the network.
